name: AiSDR
long_description:
AiSDR builds Ami, an AI sales agent that helps B2B companies find customers and book meetings.

Give Ami your website. It researches your business, recommends who to target and why now, and builds an outreach plan. Once you approve, it runs personalized campaigns across email and LinkedIn, follows up, handles replies, and books meetings.

Ami keeps working after launch. It monitors results, spots problems with targeting or messaging, and recommends changes or applies them within the rules you set. It remembers your decisions and campaign results, so each campaign builds on the last.

Built on lessons from 17,000+ real AiSDR campaigns, Ami gives founders and small teams sales strategy and execution in one place, without having to manage every step themselves.
one_liner: AI that finds the right buyers and books sales meetings

launches.title: Ami by AiSDR: AI GTM agent that builds your full outbound motion
launches.tagline: Trained on 3 years of data across 27 industries, 17k+ campaigns and 20k+ booked meetings
launches.body:
Hey YC 👋

Yuriy here - founder of AiSDR (YC S23). This is my second YC company. The first (AXDRAFT – YC W19) was acquired by Onit in 2020.

Today we’re launching **Ami**, an AI GTM agent that already knows what good outbound looks like. Ami builds your campaign, and runs it across email and LinkedIn until a meeting’s booked.

What makes it different is what happens next. Ami remembers every campaign it’s run for you, spots what isn’t working, fixes it on your say-so, and tells you what to run next.

## TL;DR

* Point Ami at your website and it builds your campaign in 20 minutes against what’s worked across 17,150+ campaigns across 27 industry-specific playbooks. 
* Every decision is driven by data, and Ami pushes back when it thinks your direction is off.
* Targeting is pain-based. Ami looks for evidence that someone has your problem right now, and validates the timing before sending a message.
* Ami remembers everything it’s run for you, so Month 3 is better than Month 1.
* Self-serve for $250/month. No demo required to start.
* **Try it at** <https://aisdr.com/ai-gtm-agent-ami/>

[Launch video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Z--7OETsjrs)

## The Problem

AI outbound got very good at scaling noise. But it struggled at making sales judgments.

Almost every AI SDR, ours included, assumed the human would bring the strategy, define the ICP, create the angle, and hit approve. The AI would take it from there and do it all faster than any human.

This works if you already know what a good campaign looks like. A lot of people buying these tools don’t:

* First-time founders running founder-led sales
* First sales hires
* 2-person GTM teams

Working out which of 42+ possible audiences is worth spending time on and deciding what to say is a skill built over years. 

So we handed that decision back to buyers and called it control. So did everyone else.

What came out the other end is thousands of messages and full dashboards, but zero pipeline.

The missing piece was never speed. It was judgment. And no one had automated it.

## Our Solution – Ami AI

For 3 years, we built execution: research, writing, sequencing, deliverability, reply handling. And the thing customers kept telling us was still hard was the part we hadn't automated – deciding what campaign to run in the first place, and when to stop and pivot to something else.

The number that settled it was 80% of our customers were using our campaign generator instead of building campaigns by hand, even though building gave them far more control. 

People wanted a decision rather than controls.

So we took what we learned from over 17,150 campaigns run on the platform in the past 3 years, and built the agent that does it. 

That's Ami.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=114134&key=user_uploads/208580/7df84866-6f8f-476e-8d12-7e12ad99005d)

### Where Ami’s judgment comes from

In a nutshell, 3 years of running outbound as a company that sells outbound. As of September 2026, this means (adding daily):

Campaigns run - 17,150

Emails sent - 2,546,096

Meetings booked - 19,501

Customers served - 1,150

Industries served - 27

Every one of those campaigns taught Ami something about what lands, in which industry, at what moment. That's the part you can't buy off the shelf, and that’s why this took three years.

**1. Ami builds your campaign from your website, CRM, and industry best practices, against everything we’ve learned:** Give Ami your URL and it reads your site, and share access to your CRM. Ami then runs what it found against your industry and the 17K+ campaigns we’ve done over 3 years, and comes back with the angles and audiences you need. You can argue with Ami: narrow the ICP, push a different angle, or ask why it picked what it did.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=114134&key=user_uploads/208580/c36e16a8-d236-41be-bb97-8f133a06f758)

**2. Ami targets pains:** Most tools match a profile and hope the timing is right. Ami looks for evidence someone has the problem you solve. There's no fixed database. Describe who you want and Ami finds them, with data verified at the time of the search.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=114134&key=user_uploads/208580/59022bd3-8755-4def-9ecb-2c47fac6b9ab)

**3. Ami remembers, and it gets better at your sales motions**: This is where Ami’s value compounds. Ami keeps every campaign it’s run for you: angles that landed, segments that went quiet, objections that kept coming up, and things you tried. It tells you what’s breaking and why when performance drops, and it makes fixes once you give the green light. Month 3 is better than Month 1 because Ami has 3 months of your outbound in its head. 

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=114134&key=user_uploads/208580/031002d5-65f8-4470-91c3-97fc2a0caae7)

An AI that learns your business and doesn’t need babysitting is what this category’s promised since Day 1 (ours included). It took 3 years, 17K campaigns, and 2.5M emails before we had enough to build it..

You don’t have to be good at outbound to win with Ami.

That’s the whole point.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=114134&key=user_uploads/208580/f47e2f0d-2f4b-4255-b482-98cecdc06982)

### **What it produces**

Medians across our customer case studies:

Connection acceptance (LinkedIn) - 32.42%

Response rate (email) - 4.92%

Positive response rate (email) - 1.02%

Positive response rate (LinkedIn) - 3.4%

Meeting booked rate - 0.54%

Meetings per 1,000 leads - 6–10

## The team

**Yuriy Zaremba (CEO)**: 2x YC founder. 8+ years in B2B sales. Previously co-founder and CEO of AXDRAFT (W19, acquired by Onit in 2020).

AiSDR’s team of 35 works across the United States, Ukraine, and Poland. 200+ customers. 4.6/5 on G2 across 101 reviews. SOC 2 certified.

## Our ask

* **Try it at** <https://aisdr.com/ai-gtm-agent-ami/>. Solo plan is $250 per month, self-serve, with no demo required. YC companies get 50% discount.
* **Share the signup link**. Send it to someone who might find it useful since signup is free.
* **Follow us on LinkedIn.** Share our launch posts.
* **Tell us what broke for you**. If you’re doing founder-led sales and you bounced off an AI outbound tool, we want to hear where it failed: targeting, messaging, execution. Conversations like this are what built Ami.
* **Intros**. B2B SaaS founders at 10-200 person companies that want to try AI outreach.

launches.title: AiSDR - AI that sells
launches.tagline: Meet AiSDR, software that reaches out and books meetings with prospects for you on auto-pilot
launches.body:
## tl;dr

**AiSDR automates sales prospecting.** Our software uses generative AI to write and send sales emails to prospective customers. Once a prospect engages, AiSDR automatically corresponds with the prospect with the goal of getting a meeting booked. In just 2 months, AiSDR already has 24 customers. The response rate of our sales emails is on par with the industry’s rate for emails written by humans. This is our second time as YC founders after we sold our first company AXDRAFT (W19) to Onit Inc.

If you want to learn more - [book a demo with us](https://calendly.com/aisdr-intro/demo).

## Problem

Do you want to scale your SDR team without growing your headcount or significantly raising your operating costs? AiSDR will make it easier for your business to stay lean and mean. 

If you’re faced with any of these challenges, AiSDR is the SDR for you:

* Inbound/outbound leads are lost because you can’t answer in <10 minutes
* You run 1-3 generic email campaigns that don’t convert because you don’t have the time to create personalized campaigns
* You’re uncomfortable with sending follow-ups because they seem “salesy” or “spammy”
* You want to scale your email outreach but you don’t have the budget to confidently hire an SDR

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=74643&key=user_uploads/208580/06a07780-7d1c-4c5e-8daf-a0db770f621d)

## Solution

**For a fraction of the cost of a full-time, in-house SDR,** AiSDR will use your leads and personas to (a) create personalized email campaigns for each lead, (b) send personalized follow-ups to leads, and (c) correspond and drive leads to book a meeting with you. 

This will help you scale your outreach without increasing headcount while giving you the freedom to experiment with campaigns before hiring your first full-time SDR.

Long story short, AiSDR is the AI SDR that will grow your pipeline, optimize SDR costs, and give you the freedom to reinvest revenue into growing your business.

## How it works

AiSDR leverages generative AI to create personalized email campaigns at scale using lead data and sales personas. Since AiSDR never needs to sleep, it will respond to and follow up with engaged leads in less than 10 minutes, ensuring that **prospective clients never fall through the cracks** due to lack of time.

AiSDR will also help with developing and fine-tuning personas, cleaning leads, and warming up inboxes so that emails don’t land in spam.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=74643&key=user_uploads/208580/913f200a-2543-4ab6-8795-ea210803c40c)

## The team

This is our second time in YC. After our first time taking part (W19), we successfully sold our company AXDRAFT to Onit. Now with 6+ years of founder-led sales under our belt, we’re keen on solving many of the pains and challenges founders experience in sales. Before AXDRAFT, Oleg was a senior software engineer at [Booking.com](http://Booking.com).

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=74643&key=user_uploads/208580/25b698d1-e20d-4461-acd1-84b74bd1e6c8)

## Our quick asks

* [Book a demo](https://calendly.com/aisdr-intro/demo) with us if you want to learn more about AiSDR and use it to scale your outbound outreach or improve your inbound conversion rates.
* Follow us on [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/company/aisdrapp/), [Twitter](https://twitter.com/getaisdr), or [Facebook](https://www.facebook.com/aisdrapp). Our inboxes are always open.
* Refer us to anyone you know who’s on the lookout for a budget-friendly solution to scale their SDR teams.
